title: Template: Customer Quote + Logo Release Form
author: Sofia Mendes
body:
## Purpose
Use this template to obtain customer permission for Redwood Inference (“Redwood”) to use:
1) Customer name and logo, and/or
2) Approved customer quotes and approved claims
in marketing and sales materials.

This is a **template**. Legal must review customer redlines. Do not send modified language to a customer without Legal approval.

---

## Instructions (internal)
1. Populate the fields in **Section A–D**.
2. Select the appropriate permission scope in **Section E**.
3. Confirm any NDA/MSA restrictions (see **Section H**).
4. Send to the customer for signature via approved e-sign workflow (or PDF signature if required by procurement).
5. Save the final signed copy to the deal folder and attach to the CRM record.

**Owner (internal):** AE or CSM initiating the request
**Legal review required when:** customer requests edits; regulated customers; requests to publish architecture diagrams; any performance claims that might be interpreted as warranties.

---

# CUSTOMER QUOTE + LOGO RELEASE FORM

**This Customer Quote + Logo Release Form (“Release”) is entered into as of:** [DATE]

## A) Parties
**Redwood:** Redwood Inference, Inc. (“Redwood”)
Address: [REDWOOD ADDRESS]

**Customer (“Customer”):** [LEGAL COMPANY NAME]
Address: [CUSTOMER ADDRESS]

## B) Customer Contact(s) and Signatory
**Customer primary marketing/legal contact:**
- Name: [NAME]
- Email: [EMAIL]
- Title: [TITLE]

**Customer approved spokesperson (for attribution, if applicable):**
- Name: [SPOKESPERSON NAME]
- Title: [SPOKESPERSON TITLE]
- Company: [COMPANY NAME]

**Customer authorized signatory:**
- Name: [SIGNATORY NAME]
- Title: [SIGNATORY TITLE]
- Email: [SIGNATORY EMAIL]

## C) Redwood Contact
- Name: [AE/CSM NAME]
- Title: [TITLE]
- Email: [EMAIL]

---

## D) Approved Materials (attach or link)
Attach final approved materials OR link to a document that contains the approved text/asset(s).

- Approved logo file(s) (vector preferred): [LINK]
- Approved customer name format (e.g., “Acme Corp” vs “ACME, Inc.”): [TEXT]
- Approved quote(s) + attribution: [LINK]
- Approved case study draft (if applicable): [LINK]
- Approved architecture diagram / screenshots (if applicable): [LINK]

---

## E) Permission Scope (check all that apply)
Customer grants Redwood the permission indicated below:

[ ] **Logo + Company Name**: Redwood may use Customer’s name and logo as a customer reference.

[ ] **Quotes**: Redwood may use the approved quotes listed in Section F, attributed as specified.

[ ] **Approved Claims / Outcomes**: Redwood may use the approved claims listed in Section G (e.g., performance/cost outcomes), subject to the measurement context and caveats provided.

[ ] **Anonymized Story Only**: Redwood may publish an anonymized case study (no logo, no company name, no identifying architecture details). The anonymized identifier to use is: [e.g., “Large US fintech”].

[ ] **Reference Calls (internal only)**: Customer agrees to participate in scheduled reference calls with qualified prospects under Redwood’s reference process. Notes from calls are for internal use only unless separately approved.

---

## F) Approved Quote(s) (copy/paste final text)
List each quote verbatim as approved. Do not paraphrase.

**Quote 1**
- Quote text: “[…]”
- Attribution name: [SPOKESPERSON NAME]
- Attribution title/company: [TITLE, COMPANY]
- Allowed context (where quote may appear): [case study / website / sales deck / press / social / other]

**Quote 2 (optional)**
- Quote text: “[…]”
- Attribution name: [NAME]
- Attribution title/company: [TITLE, COMPANY]
- Allowed context: [ … ]

**Customer restrictions on quotes (if any):**
- [e.g., no use on paid ads; no use in press releases; no use on social channels; must include specific disclaimer]

---

## G) Approved Claims / Metrics (must include context)
Only the following claims are approved for use. Claims must be presented with the measurement context below and may not be generalized beyond the specified workload.

**Claim 1**
- Approved claim text (exact): [e.g., “Reduced p95 latency from 1.9s to 1.2s for our chat endpoint under production traffic.”]
- Workload / endpoint: [describe]
- Measurement window: [dates]
- Environment / deployment mode: [Hosted / Dedicated / Private]
- Baseline definition: [describe baseline system and configuration]
- Caveats required in publication: [e.g., “results vary by prompt length and model”]

**Claim 2 (optional)**
- Approved claim text (exact): […]
- Context: […]

**Disallowed unless explicitly added above:**
- Absolute guarantees (e.g., “always,” “zero downtime,” “lowest cost,” “guaranteed latency”).
- Broad comparisons to third parties unless Customer and Redwood both approve the exact language.

---

## H) NDA / Confidentiality and Sensitive Information
This Release does not authorize disclosure of Customer confidential information.

If an NDA, MSA, or other agreement exists between the parties that restricts publicity or use of Customer marks/quotes, the parties agree that:
- This Release is intended to be consistent with that agreement; and
- If a conflict is identified, the parties will work in good faith to resolve it, and Redwood will not publish the disputed material until resolved.

**Known restrictions (check and specify):**
[ ] Customer requires prior written approval of any publication (beyond this Release).
[ ] Customer requires security/compliance review prior to publication.
[ ] Customer prohibits disclosure of: [e.g., region, cloud provider, on-prem/VPC details, model names, incident metrics].
[ ] Other: [TEXT]

---

## I) Trademark / Brand Guidelines
Redwood agrees to use Customer’s name and logo solely as authorized in this Release and in accordance with Customer’s reasonable brand guidelines provided to Redwood.

Customer retains all right, title, and interest in its trademarks and logos.

---

## J) Term, Withdrawal, and Removal SLA
**Term:** This Release begins on the Effective Date and continues for **[12 / 24 / 36] months** unless terminated earlier under this section.

**Withdrawal / revocation:** Customer may revoke this Release for future use by providing written notice to: [LEGAL@REDWOODINFERENCE.COM] with subject line “Quote/Logo Release Withdrawal – [CUSTOMER NAME].”

**Removal SLA:** Upon receipt of a valid withdrawal request, Redwood will:
- Stop using the Customer’s logo/name/quotes/claims in **new** materials within **10 business days**; and
- Make commercially reasonable efforts to remove the logo/name/quotes/claims from Redwood-controlled web properties within **30 days**.

**Limitations:** Customer acknowledges that removal may not be possible for:
- Printed materials already distributed;
- Historical sales collateral already sent to prospects; or
- Third-party publications outside Redwood’s control (e.g., partner blogs, press that has already run), though Redwood will reasonably request updates where feasible.

---

## K) No Endorsement; No Warranty
Customer’s permission under this Release does not constitute an endorsement of Redwood and does not create any warranties or commitments beyond what is expressly stated.

---

## L) Approval for Final Publication (optional, if Customer requires)
If Customer requires final sign-off on each asset prior to publication, list approvers and process here:
- Final approver name/title: [NAME/TITLE]
- Approval channel: [email / ticket / portal]
- Typical turnaround time: [X business days]

---

## M) Signatures
By signing below, Customer represents that it has the authority to grant the permissions described in this Release.

**CUSTOMER**
Legal company name: [CUSTOMER LEGAL NAME]

Signature: ________________________________
Name: [SIGNATORY NAME]
Title: [SIGNATORY TITLE]
Date: [DATE]

**REDWOOD INFERENCE, INC.**

Signature: ________________________________
Name: [AUTHORIZED REDWOOD SIGNER]
Title: [TITLE]
Date: [DATE]

---

## Appendix (internal-only guidance; remove before sending)
**Default recommended selections:**
- Early-stage public case study: Logo + Company Name + Quotes + Approved Claims
- Regulated/security-sensitive: Quotes + Approved Claims with strong caveats; consider “Anonymized Story Only”

**Where this form is used:**
- Public case studies (web/PDF)
- Sales decks and one-pagers
- Redwood website customer logo wall
- Cloud marketplace listings (if explicitly approved)

**Do not include in customer version:**
- Internal commentary, risk notes, pipeline details, or prospect names.
